# use-fs

Expanded LLM context for the RustUse fs set.

## Set links

- Canonical set page: https://rustuse.org/use-fs/
- Set overview alias: https://rustuse.org/sets/use-fs/

- Root LLM routing map: https://rustuse.org/llms.txt
- Full RustUse context: https://rustuse.org/llms-full.txt

## Routing notes

The canonical short routes are https://rustuse.org/use-fs/llms.txt and https://rustuse.org/use-fs/llms-full.txt. The /sets/use-fs/ aliases serve this exact generated content so the two paths cannot drift.
